summary: Configured `/srv/inventory` as a persistent bind mount at `/mnt/inventory` on node1. A safe reboot confirmed the mount and test data survived into a new boot.
actions_performed: Rebooted node1 exactly once and verified full recovery.

evidence.summary: fstab validation succeeded; after reboot, the mount unit was active and `/mnt/inventory` resolved to `/srv/inventory`.
Captured healthy baseline boot ID and matching source/target data, received reboot acknowledgement, observed a changed boot ID, and confirmed the system, mount, configuration, and data recovered.
